audit_name: Audit Subagent 3 - Suite J (Streaming) & Suite K (Cancellation) Audit

suite_j_streaming_audit.summary: Suite J audits live SSE and AgentRuntime streaming. 2 critical streaming defects were confirmed in live execution and source code.

FAIL_J05_confirmation.mechanism: Simulated timer streaming via list() buffering in thread executor + synthetic sleep
FAIL_J05_confirmation.source_evidence: core/agents/runtime.py lines 459-467: `def _do_stream(): return list(gemini.stream_text(...))` executed via `chunks = await loop.run_in_executor(None, _do_stream)` followed by `for ch in chunks: yield ...; await asyncio.sleep(0.01)`
FAIL_J05_confirmation.finding: CRITICAL ARCHITECTURAL DEFECT: runtime.step_stream_async completely buffers all chunks from Gemini into a Python list before yielding any data, followed by synthetic pacing via await asyncio.sleep(0.01).

FAIL_J02_confirmation.finding: First chunk arrived at 11.433s out of 11.724s total duration (97.5% of total time elapsed before first token delivered). Conclusively proves no live streaming to client occurred until full generation finished.

J01_long_conversational_request.evidence: Total events: 19, chunk count: 18, total duration: 11.724s.

J03_incremental_chunks.evidence: Chunk count: 18, synthetic inter-chunk delta sample: [0.0245, 0.0159, 0.0162, 0.0146, 0.0155, 0.0153, 0.0161, 0.0159, 0.0159, 0.0158] (avg delta: 0.0162s, driven by asyncio.sleep(0.01)).

J04_frontend_sse_contract.evidence: HTTP 200, Content-Type: 'text/event-stream; charset=utf-8', verified has_status_event=True, has_chunk_event=True, has_done_event=True.

J06_completion_events.evidence: Verified SSE 'done' event emitted: event: done, data: {"reply": "Hello, Lead Architect.", "conversation_id": "conv_c270f53afa2e", "agent_id": "MICHAEL"}.

J07_streaming_errors.evidence: Tested non-existent agent query; received error event: 'event: error\ndata: {"error": "Agent Non-Existent not found."}' followed by done event.

J08_empty_response_handling.evidence: Tested empty prompt payload; received error event: 'event: error\ndata: {"error": "Prompt cannot be empty."}' followed by done event.

J09_conversation_persistence.evidence: Conversation conv_d862b076c0f2 persisted 2 messages; user_persisted=True, assistant_persisted=True.

J10_provider_and_context_architecture.evidence: Verified provider: Google Gemini (tier=fast, gemini.stream_text), context assembly via AgentRuntime.build_system_prompt() + load_messages(), streaming endpoint /api/agents/chat/stream, consumer streamAgentChat in frontend/src/lib/api.ts.

suite_k_cancellation_audit.summary: Detailed inspection of qa_artifacts/run_suite_k_tests.py shows tests K01-K06 were executed against an in-memory mock harness (MockUI and mock_llm_stream), while K07-K11 executed against real live Win32 Job Objects via ProcessSupervisor.

k01_k06_audit.execution_method: In qa_artifacts/run_suite_k_tests.py: test_k01_k06_conversational_cancellation uses MockUI and an async mock generator mock_llm_stream() that yields chunk_1..chunk_99 with asyncio.sleep(0.05).
k01_k06_audit.improper_label_in_qa_test_results: Labelled as 'LIVE APPLICATION TEST' in QA_TEST_RESULTS.json (inaccurate, must be re-labelled as 'MOCKED / SIMULATED TEST').
k01_k06_audit.findings: Tests successfully validated asyncio.CancelledError propagation and UI abort handling in an event loop simulation, but did NOT connect to live Gemini Live WebSocket or live HTTP streaming endpoint.

k07_k11_audit.execution_method: In qa_artifacts/run_suite_k_tests.py: test_k07_k11_process_supervisor_cancellation creates a real deep_tree_worker.py temporary script that spawns real subprocesses (parent -> child PID 27864 -> grandchild PID 27864) wrapped by ProcessSupervisor.spawn() using Win32 Job Objects (JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE).
k07_k11_audit.verification_evidence: Parent root PID 21040, child PID 27864, grandchild PID 27864 were verified alive via psutil.pid_exists(), then terminate_tree() terminated all PIDs in 0.0002s with zero orphan processes remaining.
k07_k11_audit.label_recommendation: Accurately categorized as LIVE PROCESS TEST.

k12_audit.execution_method: Executed against live TaskManager instance; cancelled background task and executed 20 status queries with avg latency 0.866ms, max latency 1.631ms.
